read.en: Applied Optoelectronics jumped 6.6% on Oct 26 to $71.94, trading between $66.51 and $74.39. It is below the falling 5-day ($72.3), 10-day ($78.3), 30-day ($96.9) and 100-day ($118.7) averages and the rising 200-day ($113.3). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 13 and below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 12 ($94.47), and RSI is 35.
read.zh: Applied Optoelectronics 10月26日大涨 6.6%，收于 $71.94，盘中区间 $66.51–74.39。股价位于下行的 5 日（$72.3）、10 日（$78.3）、30 日（$96.9）和 100 日均线（$118.7）以及上行的 200 日均线（$113.3）下方。MACD 自 10月13日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月12日起看空（$94.47），RSI 为 35。

read.en: The close cleared $71.2 (Oct 23 high); the $74.4 high poked above the $73 break level but did not hold. Resistance is $72.3–74.4 (5-day, Oct 20 low, Oct 26 high), then $76 (Jul 29 low) and $78.3 (10-day). Support is $71.2, then $65.6–66.5 (Oct 22 and 26 lows, Feb 27 gap low) and $60. A close above $74.4 would target $76–78; below $65.6, $60.
read.zh: 收盘站上 $71.2（10月23日高点）；盘中高点 $74.4 一度突破 $73 破位水平，但未能守住。阻力为 $72.3–74.4（5 日均线、10月20日低点、10月26日高点），其次 $76（7月29日低点）和 $78.3（10 日均线）。支撑为 $71.2，其次 $65.6–66.5（10月22日和26日低点、2月27日缺口低点）和 $60。若收盘站上 $74.4，下一目标看 $76–78；跌破 $65.6 则看 $60。

s.en: Oct 22 and Oct 26 lows ($66.3–66.5); Feb 27 gap low $65.6
